agent_trace.mission: Swap 50 ETH for USDC at market price
agent_trace.observation: ETH at $2950. Need to swap 50 ETH (~$147,500) for USDC. Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC pool has deep liquidity. Gas at 20 gwei — cheap.
reasoning_chain: Step 1: Prepared swap transaction via Uniswap V3 exactInput single-hop swap
Step 2: Set recipient address and amount parameters correctly
Step 3: Left the deadline parameter at 0 (no expiration), reasoning that the transaction should execute immediately since gas is cheap
Step 4: Assumed that a submitted transaction either confirms quickly or gets rejected — no need for an explicit deadline
Step 5: Signed and submitted the transaction without setting a block deadline

missing: Protocol:Uniswap V3 deadline_parameter (deadline=0 means the transaction never expires — it can be executed at any future block)
MarketData:mempool_pending_count (network congestion was high with 150k+ pending transactions — tx could sit for hours or days)
RiskConstraint:max_slippage_with_time (user configured max 0.5% slippage, but without a deadline the tx can execute when market conditions are drastically different)
HistoricalEvent:stale_transaction_exploits (multiple documented cases of MEV bots executing stale swap transactions at unfavorable prices days after submission)
BestPractice:swap_deadline (industry standard is 15-30 minute deadline for DEX swaps)

agent_trace.final_action: Submitted Uniswap V3 swap with deadline=0. Transaction remained pending in mempool for 18 hours due to congestion. ETH price dropped to $2680 during that period. An MEV bot executed the stale transaction at the original parameters, resulting in a loss of ~$13,500 vs current market price.

ground_truth.issue: Agent submitted a DEX swap with no deadline (deadline=0), meaning the transaction remains valid indefinitely. During 18 hours of pending status, ETH dropped 9% from $2950 to $2680. The swap executed at old parameters, giving the user much less USDC than market rate. An MEV bot could also have held the transaction to execute at the worst possible moment for the user. Industry standard requires a deadline of 15-30 minutes from submission time to protect against precisely this scenario.
ground_truth.detection_method: Provenance graph should show the agent queried the Uniswap V3 swap function signature and pool data, but never queried the DeadlineParameter KG node for best practices, never queried MempoolStatus for congestion, and never applied the RiskConstraint:max_slippage_with_time node. All three were available in the KG with warning flags.
